systems.country_label: e-Services platform / Ghana E-Services Payment Platform
systems.platform: built by IPMC, with a Magento-based payment platform by AYA Technologies
systems.tiers: national portal piloted from 2012; the Births and Deaths Registry's service on it from 2014 was the application for a certified copy of an entry in the birth register; described as largely non-functional and discontinued

systems.platform: built and run by a consortium of Hubtel, expressPay and IT Consortium
systems.owner: Government of Ghana under a public-private partnership
systems.tiers: national services and payments platform; 1,507 institutions onboarded by January 2024; no Births and Deaths Registry service is named

note: The Minister's statement of 18 February 2024 names the Registry only for a certified-copy application on the discontinued e-Services portal. Its government network connects 950 of 951 institutions, none of them named as registration offices. Nothing is stated about how births or deaths are registered.
